mod_gnb.meaning: The metric of the author's notebook (before the author's order of 2026-10-14 added the factor $b_4$ to the extra-time components), written as the diagonal matrix of its components in the order $x_0, x_1, \dots, x_7$; it is quoted for comparison only, the model uses the corrected metric $\bar g_{MN}$.

mod_hTTrms.meaning: The root-mean-square amplitude of the primordial transverse-traceless (tensor) metric perturbation per logarithmic interval of the wavenumber, the size of the gravitational-wave term of the first-order metric.

mod_rts.meaning: The tensor-to-scalar ratio: the power of the primordial tensor perturbations divided by the power $A_{\mathrm{s}}$ of the primordial curvature perturbations at the pivot scale.

mod_ih.meaning: The label $h = 1, 2, 3$ of the author's real $4\times4$ matrices $\mathsf{s}_h$, $\mathsf{t}_h$ and of the $8\times8$ matrices $\mathsf{Z}_h$ and $\mathsf{Z}_{7-h}$ built from them.

mod_ikq.meaning: The row and column indices $k, q = 1, 2, 3, 4$ of the author's $4\times4$ matrices $\mathsf{s}_h$ and $\mathsf{t}_h$.

mod_epsLC.meaning: The Levi-Civita symbol of four indices: $+1$ if $(h, k, q, 4)$ is an even permutation of $(1, 2, 3, 4)$, $-1$ if it is an odd permutation, and 0 if two indices are equal.

mod_sh.meaning: The author's real antisymmetric $4\times4$ matrices $\mathsf{s}_h$ ($h = 1, 2, 3$; in the notebook $s_h = Q_a - Q_b$), the building blocks of the matrices $\mathsf{Z}_1$, $\mathsf{Z}_2$, $\mathsf{Z}_3$.

mod_th.meaning: The author's real antisymmetric $4\times4$ matrices $\mathsf{t}_h$ ($h = 1, 2, 3$; in the notebook $t_h = Q_a + Q_b$), the building blocks of the matrices $\mathsf{Z}_6$, $\mathsf{Z}_5$, $\mathsf{Z}_4$.

mod_Za.meaning: The author's real $8\times8$ matrices $\mathsf{Z}_a$ ($a = 0, \dots, 7$; the notebook's $\zeta_A = \tau_A$): $\mathsf{Z}_0$ is the identity, $\mathsf{Z}_1, \mathsf{Z}_2, \mathsf{Z}_3$ and $\mathsf{Z}_6, \mathsf{Z}_5, \mathsf{Z}_4$ are built from $\mathsf{s}_h$ and $\mathsf{t}_h$, and $\mathsf{Z}_7 = \mathsf{Z}_1\cdots\mathsf{Z}_6$; they are the lower-left $8\times8$ blocks of the gamma matrices $\gamma^a$.

mod_Zbar.meaning: The partner matrices $\bar{\mathsf{Z}}_a = \mathsf{S}\,\mathsf{Z}_a^T\,\mathsf{S}$ of the author ($a = 0, \dots, 7$; the notebook's $\bar\tau_A$), the upper-right $8\times8$ blocks of the gamma matrices $\gamma^a$.

mod_Ssf.meaning: The author's real $8\times8$ matrix with the $4\times4$ identity in its two off-diagonal blocks and zeros elsewhere (the notebook's $\sigma$); $\mathsf{S} = \mathsf{Z}_1\mathsf{Z}_2\mathsf{Z}_3 = \mathsf{Z}_4\mathsf{Z}_5\mathsf{Z}_6\mathsf{Z}_7$.

mod_Gamma8.meaning: The chirality of eight dimensions, $\Gamma_8 = \gamma^{x_0}\gamma^{x_1}\cdots\gamma^{x_7}$, equal to $\mathrm{diag}(-\mathbf{1}, \mathbf{1})$ for the author's matrices; its eigenspaces (eigenvalues $-1$ and $+1$) are the two inequivalent 8-dimensional irreducible representations of Spin(4,4).

mod_anomaly2.meaning: Two further anomaly coefficients of one generation (every zero mode written as a left-handed Weyl field, a right-handed one with the hypercharge $-Y$): the mixed gravitational-hypercharge anomaly $\mathfrak{A}_{\mathrm{grav^2U(1)}} = \sum N_{\mathrm{col}}N_{\mathrm{dbl}}Y$ over all components, and the cubic colour anomaly $\mathfrak{A}_{\mathrm{SU(3)^3}}$ (the number of left-handed minus right-handed colour triplets, weighted with their isospin multiplicity); the theory is consistent only if they vanish.

mod_SI9.meaning: The action of the chiral tip $Z$ portal I9 of version 1, which coupled the four-dimensional left-handed current of dirac16complex to the $Z$ part of the current of the tip sigma field; removed from UM-2 in version 2 (its coefficients are set to zero).

mod_cZ.meaning: The coefficients of the removed portal I9: $c_{\mathrm{Z}}$ of its part that is even under the fold reflection, $\tilde c_{\mathrm{Z}}$ of its oriented (odd) part; UM-2 sets both to zero.

mod_varsigmat.meaning: The sign ($+1$ or $-1$) that distinguishes the two sides of a tip (the tips at $z \to 0^+$ and $z \to \pi^-$ of neighbouring periods), used only in the oriented part of the removed portal I9.

mod_kt.meaning: The wave number (momentum) of a mode along the compact extra times $x_5, x_6, x_7$; UM-2 keeps the good sector $k_{\mathrm{t}} = 0$, because a mode with $k_{\mathrm{t}} > fM$ would be tachyonic.

mod_Ndot.meaning: The number emission rates of a supernova neutrinosphere (neutrinos per unit time, proportional to the luminosity divided by the mean energy): $\dot N_{\mathrm{e}}$ of the electron neutrinos, $\dot N_{\bar{\mathrm{e}}}$ of the electron antineutrinos, $\dot N_{\mathrm{x}}$ of each heavy-lepton flavour; $\dot N_{\mathrm{pair}} = \frac23(\dot N_{\bar{\mathrm{e}}} - \dot N_{\mathrm{x}})$ is the rate of electron neutrino-antineutrino pairs turned into heavy-lepton pairs by lepton-number-conserving pair conversion.

mod_Ebar.meaning: The mean energies of the neutrinos emitted by a supernova neutrinosphere: of the electron neutrinos, of the electron antineutrinos and of each heavy-lepton flavour.

mod_EbarEarth.meaning: The mean energies of the electron neutrinos and of the electron antineutrinos of a supernova at the Earth, after the MSW conversion in the envelope (the emitted spectra weighted with the survival probability and the number emission rates).

mod_Eh.meaning: The rate at which the neutrinos heat the matter behind a supernova shock by charged-current absorption (up to a common factor): $\dot E_{\mathrm{h}}$ without flavour conversion, $\dot E_{\mathrm{h}}^{\mathrm{eq}}$ with full flavour equipartition, $\dot E_{\mathrm{h}}^{\mathrm{pair}}$ with lepton-number-conserving pair conversion (schematic estimate).
mod_Eh.units: energy per time (relative values are used)
mod_Eh.value: ratios 0.884 and 0.760 to the unconverted rate
